entry.title: U.S. Sanctions BitBank Over Alleged Bitcoin Transfers to Iran's IRGC
entry.content:
Techmeme | coindesk.com | source

The U.S. Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) has targeted Tehran-based cryptocurrency exchange BitBank and software developer Pishtaz Simorgh Electronic Trade Company in a new sanctions action. The agency claims the exchange facilitated hundreds of millions of dollars in Bitcoin transfers to the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) and handled fees collected by the Hormuz Safe Marine Services Authority for vessel passage through the Strait of Hormuz.

These designations, part of the "Operation Economic Outcast" campaign, freeze BitBank's assets in U.S. jurisdiction and expose foreign firms to secondary sanctions if they facilitate BitBank transactions. Notably, this enforcement action did not include any specific cryptocurrency wallet addresses.

entry.content:
Lobsters Top | mcsweeneys.net | discussion | hacker news

The piece critiques Big Tech industry trends, specifically mocking subscription-based consumer protections, the expansion of product ecosystems, and the application of unmonitored technology to complex global issues. It envisions a future requiring "Shit-umbrellas" and "Shit Dams" to manage the resulting deluge.
